truths.evidence: Live end-to-end probe on a throwaway .planning with 5 empty adjudications + 3 escalated resolves (stakes critical) and NO config layer returned: model.effort.cad-planner {direction:'raise', current:"unset: no config layer pins this, so the stakes level (critical) decides it", proposed:'xhigh'} and review.triggers.plan.gate with the same unset current and NO proposed (an unset gate has no ladder position - D-06/D-07). Live `trace suggest --phase 2` on this repo returns the R4 entry with direction 'lower', current 8 and no `proposed`, while all 7 info receipts carry none of the three keys (D-12). Seam trace: cadence-core/bin/planning.mjs:3045-3080 suggestResolution() reads values/gates/rungs/stakes and passes them into suggestFromRender at :3371; cadence-core/bin/lib/trace-suggest.mjs:139-155 keyState() and :121-137 unsetCurrent() land them on the entry. Named test `SGT-01: \`trace suggest\` returns a direction, a current, and a proposed where the record prices one` (cadence-core/bin/trace-suggest.test.mjs:804) runs the CLI against a real repo config layer and pins gate blocking->advisory and effort high->xhigh; passes.

truths.truth: The ceiling rule is SUPPRESSED when every checkpoint it counted maps to a readable plan under the resolved ceiling, and an unreadable plan counts as UNKNOWN rather than under-ceiling
truths.evidence: cadence-core/bin/lib/trace-suggest.mjs:470-486 - `bounded` requires a finite resolved ceiling, counted.length === execCp, execCp > 0 and every count strictly < ceiling; the suggestion is pushed only when !bounded. The ceiling compared is `resolved(resolution,'workflow.max_plan_tasks')`, never a literal 8 (D-10). cadence-core/bin/planning.mjs:3008-3030 checkpointPlanTasks() returns null (UNKNOWN) for a bad phase, a missing plan key, no matching PLAN-<n>.md/PLAN.md, or an unreadable file. Named test `SGT-01: R4 goes silent when every checkpoint it counted maps to a plan under the ceiling` (cadence-core/bin/trace-suggest.test.mjs:438) covers all four arms - [4,3] suppresses, [4,null] speaks, [4,8] speaks (equal is not under), and ceiling 12 with [9,10] suppresses; passes.

truths.truth: AC2's second clause: on this repo, `trace suggest --phase 2` returns no ceiling suggestion
truths.evidence: Live: `node cadence-core/bin/planning.mjs trace suggest --phase 2` still returns {kind:'suggest', action:'workflow.max_plan_tasks', direction:'lower', current:8}. The live record's three phase-2 cad-executor checkpoints carry plan keys `1`, `1-fix` and `1-cut` (.planning/trace.jsonl, corr 2-b3748a4 and 2-fc162e3); the latter two are WORKER keys that map to no plan file, so checkpointPlanTasks returns null for them and D-09 (CONTEXT.md:156-167) makes UNKNOWN never under-ceiling, which leaves the rule speaking. The code is correct and the criterion is not: AC2's second clause contradicts D-09 in the same CONTEXT, and it cannot be met on this record without breaking the D-09 rule that truth 2 verifies. gaps.name: the ceiling rule goes silent when its evidence does not bind
gaps.reason: behavior wrong - only against the criterion's second clause, not against the code. The suppression rule and the UNKNOWN degradation are implemented, wired and covered by a passing named test, but the clause 'on this repo, trace suggest --phase 2 returns no ceiling suggestion' is false at HEAD and cannot be made true without violating D-09.
gaps.evidence: Live `node cadence-core/bin/planning.mjs trace suggest --phase 2` returns {kind:'suggest', subject:'cad-executor', action:'workflow.max_plan_tasks', direction:'lower', current:8}. .planning/trace.jsonl holds three phase-2 cad-executor checkpoints with plan keys `1`, `1-fix`, `1-cut`; the last two are worker keys that map to no PLAN-*.md, so cadence-core/bin/planning.mjs:3008-3030 returns null for them and cadence-core/bin/lib/trace-suggest.mjs:470-474 refuses to treat UNKNOWN as under-ceiling, which is exactly what CONTEXT.md D-09 (:156-167) requires. AC2's own first half and its second half therefore contradict each other on this record. SUMMARY.md Open items records it as unmet by design.
gaps.missing: No code change. Amend AC2's second clause in .planning/phases/5/CONTEXT.md and UAT item 2's `expected` so the live clause is stated as conditional on every counted checkpoint resolving to a readable plan - e.g. 'on a record whose executor checkpoints all map to readable under-ceiling plans, no ceiling suggestion is returned; on this repo the `1-cut`/`1-fix` worker keys are UNKNOWN, so the rule correctly still speaks'. If the clause is meant to stay literal instead, the decision to reopen is D-09 itself, which truth 2's test pins.
